svg.title: Known-best packing of 304 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=304 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 8a8879a rational centre/half-angle certificate of an exact descent of a public Kaggle packing, read exactly from the retained source file. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, same-packing, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=304 known best: side ~ 17.9268989 (certified upper bound)
